contests.title: Burlington — Measure GM: Municipal swimming pool bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Des Moines County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote: Shall the City of Burlington, in Des Moines County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $7,000,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, renovating and improving municipal swimming pool facilities?

measures.questionText: Shall the City of Burlington, in Des Moines County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $7,000,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, renovating and improving municipal swimming pool facilities?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $7 million in general-obligation bonds to construct, renovate and improve municipal swimming pool facilities.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the municipal swimming pool borrowing.
